name: Business Casual
tagline: Polished but relaxed: the modern workplace look.
description: Approachable professional photos for team pages, LinkedIn, résumés and company blogs. Open-collar shirts, knitwear and soft blazers in bright offices, cafés and coworking spaces, with candid moments that feel like a real day at work instead of a stiff studio session.
